text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a methodological paper describing the development and parameterization of a modeling framework (LUCAS) for the conterminous U.S. While it involves land-use and land-cover (LULC) prediction, its primary focus is on detailing the input data, harmonization methods, and spatially-explicit parameters for the model.
